description: Land Title Settlement Department - Uduwana, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content deals specifically with land title registration and intestate property claims, which falls under land and property-related matters. The notices call for claims to property of deceased individuals without wills, provide detailed land parcel information (cadastral maps, parcel numbers, extents), and reference the Registration of Title Act for establishing land ownership. This clearly fits the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land registration and property ownership matters.
